title: A deposit link paid with the Bill To unchanged lands on the payer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a shop that uses the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, with contact A1, who can sign in to the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with contact B1, who can sign in to the customer portal.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer B, with no deposit taken.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Create a deposit link for $25.00.
  4. Open the deposit link in another browser.
  5. Pay the $25.00 with a test card.
  6. Open customer B's Deposits tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows its deposit actions.

Step 3:

  • A deposit link for $25.00 is made.

Step 4:

  • The portal payment page for $25.00 opens.

Step 5:

  • The payment goes through.

Step 6:

  • The $25.00 deposit for work order 1 is listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
